# Email-hygiene exception ledger — read by scripts/email-allowlist.mjs.
#
# SCOPE: time-boxed exceptions only.
#
#   The sanctioned identity forms are NOT listed here. They live in
#   scripts/email-allowlist.mjs as AUTHOR_POLICY / COMMITTER_POLICY, so that
#   widening the policy means changing code a reviewer reads, not appending a
#   line to a data file.
#
# RECORD FORMAT (tab-separated, one record per line; blank lines and '#' comments ignored):
#
#   <kind>\t<ERE pattern>\t<expires:YYYY-MM-DD>\t<approver>\t<reason>
#
#   kind      author | committer | both — which column the exception applies to
#   pattern   POSIX ERE, joined with '|' and fed to `grep -E`
#   expires   ISO date; the record MUST be deleted on or before that day
#   approver  GitHub login that approved the exception
#   reason    why, and what removes the need for it
#
# RULES ENFORCED BY `node scripts/email-allowlist.mjs --check`
# (run by .github/workflows/email-gate.yml on every PR and push, and by
# test/scripts/email-allowlist.test.ts):
#
#   1. A real personal mailbox is NEVER allowed here. gmail / qq / 163 / 126 /
#      outlook / hotmail / icloud / yahoo / *.local and any other personal
#      address is rejected outright, expiry or not. Exceptions exist for
#      noreply-FORM variants only (an account whose address is still the id-less
#      `users.noreply.github.com` form, for example) —
#      and even then the fix is to correct the address, not to keep the entry.
#
#      Why this rule exists: in Sep 2026 two real mailboxes were allowlisted as
#      "temporary" entries in the workflow file itself (PR #373 and its
#      predecessor). Neither was a noreply form, neither had an expiry, and both
#      sat in the public repository until #376 retired them. That is how a
#      one-off merge accident became a permanent hole, so the addresses are
#      deliberately NOT written down here.
#
#   2. Every record needs an expiry date and a named approver. An expired record
#      fails the gate: the expected end state of an exception is deletion.
#
# ACTIVE EXCEPTIONS: none (as of 2026-09-23).
